chatParticipants.name: smarty
chatParticipants.description: Compare Raw vs. Deterministically Optimized prompts on real workspace files via Copilot (vscode.lm) or HuggingFace (app.py).

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Run Raw vs. Optimized prompt side-by-side on the downstream LLM and audit compliance

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Inspect deterministic optimization telemetry and Old vs. New prompt stats without calling an LLM

nlpSmarty.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter (auto-detects NLP-start/bin/python or .venv/bin/python if left as python3).

nlpSmarty.engineDirectory.description: Path to directory containing bridge_server.py, app.py, and pipeline.py (defaults to extension root).

nlpSmarty.autoShowLogs.description: Automatically reveal the NLP-Smarty Optimizer Output panel when an optimization runs.

nlpSmarty.optimizeOnSave.description: Automatically update the alongside Old vs. New Prompt Comparison Inspector whenever a file is saved.

nlpSmarty.downstreamBackend.description: Downstream LLM backend for side-by-side comparison ('auto' uses vscode.lm Copilot if available, else HuggingFace app.py).

nlpSmarty.huggingFaceToken.description: Optional HuggingFace API token (HF_TOKEN) when using the HuggingFace app.py backend.

nlpSmarty.huggingFaceModel.description: HuggingFace model ID for app.py downstream evaluation.

nlpSmarty.maxTokenBudget.description: Maximum total token budget for the compiled prompt payload.
